authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 9190 Bahutva explicitly gives Bengali/Assamese bahut, Oriya bout and regional bahota many. These bohut responses fit that abundance family; influence from prabhūta is retained as discussed by Turner. Exact form bohut is preserved; possible intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
